pilot_eligibility.selection: maximum native Student likelihood; ties choose earliest attempt

scope: Development capability and score-table checks, not an exhaustive selection study.
gate: Every attempted fit and selected profile must qualify; failures remain in the denominator.
starts: K-means and weighted moments use X only; truth labels/parameters are never supplied to fitting.
validation_rule: One new48-capability/12-table batch, locked until reviewed source freeze and complete development regression. Earlier failed v3 validation remains reported. Any change after release ends independent validation; no seed substitution.
development_change: Reviewed two-stage smooth optimizer schedule within unchanged budgets; statistical settings, family domains, starts and tolerances unchanged from v3.
proposal_status: numerical hybrid review and source freeze pending
incumbent_rule: Every numerically qualified attempted Gaussian/Student pilot remains an incumbent for every comparison method, even when unsuitable as a posterior source. Every fresh pipeline pays all attempted pilot/bootstrap work once.
development_rule: Original48 capability and12 table cases, plus both observed failed v3 validation tables as explicitly labelled development regressions. Replays are not fresh validation.
